browser.basis: Latest result for every current test file on the identical application, dependencies and Playwright configuration. A changed app invalidates all old runs; a changed test invalidates results from that test file. Raw failed and successful runs remain archived.

dimensionalReview.basis: Actual shared-vertex comparisons and selected deck-plane, bank-stagger, containment, shaft, route-join, belt and decklid-clearance checks; independent of browser interaction results.

unresolvedReferences.reason: Physical measurement surface requires confirmation; apron contour reconstructed from production profile and photographs.

bodyDimensions.basis: Selected published nominal dimensions measured on the reconstructed body mesh; not factory surface/tooling certification.
